dialogues.speaker: Omesov
dialogues.text: Uh... Well, I don't love admitting it, but I was short on Mora back then, and the Fatui's Mora is as good as anyone else's. That's why I signed up.

dialogues.speaker: Omesov
dialogues.text: After slaving away for them day and night for a full month, they fired me for some cruddy "breach of contract" — I didn't get to see a single coin at the end of it!

dialogues.speaker: Omesov
dialogues.text: Gah! First time I'd ever been fired, too... Embarrassing, is what it was...
